name: Pathways Internships
what_you_do: Paid summer interns pick one area of parks and recreation to try. Areas include outdoor lessons, camps, events, farm and garden work, and IT and GIS. Interns build job skills at Development Days.
who_can_apply: Meant for young people, most of all those who face barriers to work. The minimum age depends on the role. It is 15 for Explorers Camp and Community Engagement. It is 16 for Outdoor Education, Farm Garden, Outdoor Recreation School and IT/GIS. It is 18 for several others.
duration: June through August, about 20 hours a week (some roles 40)
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 program are closed. Next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: The page does not describe the steps. Contact Char Myers (Char.Myers@threeriversparks.org) or Terrell Lhotka (Terrell.Lhotka@threeriversparks.org).
notes: The Three Rivers Park District Foundation gives rides money if getting to work is a barrier. The work permit rule was not checked.
